title: Saponins from Dioscorea nipponinca Makino rehabilitate UVB-induced skin photoaging by inhibiting oxidative stress and apoptosis via targeting STAT3.
authors: Cai, Qing; Zhang, Qiyu; Zhang, Yan; Xue, Xuna; Han, Lan; Peng, Jinyong
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究薯蓣皂苷通过靶向STAT3抑制氧化应激和凋亡改善皮肤光老化，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Skin photoaging is one of the main causes of disability, and there are few effective methods for the treatment. In recent years, some studies have demonstrated that natural saponins have bioactivity against skin photoaging. However, the pharmacological data, targets and molecular mechanisms are limited. Dioscorea nipponinca Makino processes various pharmacological actions. To date, there have been no reports on the actions of it against skin photoaging. PURPOSE: Total saponins from D. nipponinca Makino (TSDN) were isolated for investigating the activity and mechanisms against skin photoaging. METHODS: UPLC-MS/MS was used for chemical identification and determination. The skin photoaging model was constructed by UVB irradiation on HaCaT cells and C57/BL mice. The activity of TSDN was evaluated by biochemical and pathological analyses. The potential targets of the components in TSDN were predicted by the Swiss Target Prediction database. The binding relationships between the components and the target were verified by molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, cell thermal shift assay (CETSA) and surface plasmon resonance (SPR). The molecular mechanism underlying the anti-photoaging of TSND was further investigated by gene overexpression, immunofluorescence and western blotting tests. RESULTS: TSDN, primarily containing diosgenin, dioscin, trillin, pseudoproto -dioscin and protodioscin, exhibited significant protective effects against skin photoaging by attenuating UVB-induced oxidative stress and apoptosis. STAT3 was the target of TSDN against skin photoaging. After overexpression of STAT3, TSDN lost its ability to resist skin photoaging, which was also no longer able to adjust the signal. CONCLUSION: TSDN showed the potential to rehabilitate UVB-induced skin photoaging by inhibiting oxidative stress and apoptosis via targeting of STAT3.
abstract_zh: 背景：皮肤光老化是导致残疾的主要原因之一，目前有效的治疗方法很少。近年来，一些研究表明天然皂苷具有抗皮肤光老化的生物活性。然而，其药理学数据、靶点和分子机制有限。穿龙薯蓣（Dioscorea nipponinca Makino）具有多种药理作用。迄今为止，尚无关于其抗皮肤光老化作用的报道。目的：分离穿龙薯蓣总皂苷（TSDN），研究其抗皮肤光老化的活性及机制。方法：采用UPLC-MS/MS进行化学鉴定和测定。通过UVB照射HaCaT细胞和C57/BL小鼠构建皮肤光老化模型。通过生化和病理学分析评估TSDN的活性。利用Swiss Target Prediction数据库预测TSDN中成分的潜在靶点。通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和表面等离子体共振（SPR）验证成分与靶点之间的结合关系。通过基因过表达、免疫荧光和蛋白质印迹试验进一步研究TSDN抗光老化的分子机制。结果：TSDN主要含有薯蓣皂苷元、薯蓣皂苷、三角叶薯蓣苷、伪原薯蓣皂苷和原薯蓣皂苷，通过减轻UVB诱导的氧化应激和凋亡，表现出显著的抗皮肤光老化保护作用。STAT3是TSDN抗皮肤光老化的靶点。STAT3过表达后，TSDN失去抗皮肤光老化的能力，也不再能调节信号。结论：TSDN通过靶向STAT3抑制氧化应激和凋亡，显示出修复UVB诱导皮肤光老化的潜力。
